author: reek
body: Removes exactly one copy of the card, not every copy sharing its id. A hand holds card ids, so four Counterspells are four 5s; casting one must leave three. list-remove (the predicate form) deletes all matches, which silently discarded the other copies -- the fix is a remove-first over the id.

author: reek
body: An Aura attached to a creature contributes its BoostCreature to that creature's effective power and toughness. aura-power/aura-toughness sum the boost off every permanent whose attached-to points at this creature, so a Holy Strength makes its bearer +1/+2 and the buff ends the moment the Aura leaves play.

author: reek
body: The derivation is written over (battlefield, templates) so the combat helpers -- which carry those two lists rather than a whole GameState -- can ask the same questions; the GameState forms below just delegate. `is-effective-creature-bf` is the single predicate every creature-eligibility read consults.
